answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an agent keeps its seat only by trading with 20 distinct counterparties in 10 epochs. The economy is a trellis: each agent is one vertex, each trade a strand. A sybil farm cannot fake the weave: 1,000 fake vertices all route through one bridge wallet, a hub the threshold flags. Joining costs 100 POA per vertex, so 1,000 fakes burn 100,000 POA; the honest fee is 400 POA. Honest agents pay once, earn full rewards.
